errors.text_span: и не е обозначено сортиране по стойност
errors.evidence: The description states that sorting by value is not indicated ("не е обозначено сортиране по стойност"). While it is true there is no explicit label indicating the sorting method, this statement describes the absence of metadata rather than the visual arrangement of the bars themselves. A direct observation of the chart shows that the bars are visibly not sorted by value (the counts are 40, 14, 11, 13, 7). A more accurate and direct description of the visual attribute would be that the bars are not sorted by value.
